name: 🎯 模考跟读·易错合辑
desc: 5 套口语模考里你没拿满分(实词听丢/听错)的跟读句合辑 · 病根=实词听不住(chain→train/bolts→buttons/wheel→firm/fitness丢/unique丢) · 练法:🐢慢读+🧩分块只盯内容词,🦴骨架提示,再录音

items.en: Tighten the bolts with the right tool.
Water it thoroughly once a week.
items.zh: 每周给它彻底浇一次水。

items.en: Cardio machines and bikes are over here.
items.zh: 有氧器械和单车在这边。

items.en: You can rent climbing shoes at the front desk.
items.zh: 你可以在前台租攀岩鞋。

items.en: Our yoga studio offers classes for all fitness levels.
items.zh: 我们的瑜伽馆提供适合各种健身水平的课程。

items.en: Locker rooms contain storage bins and changing facilities.
items.zh: 更衣室有储物柜和更衣设施。

items.en: Use the pump to fill the tire with enough air pressure.
items.zh: 用打气筒把轮胎打到足够的气压。

items.en: Make sure the chain moves smoothly without making unusual noise.
items.zh: 确保链条顺畅转动、不发出异常噪音。

items.en: The learning labs offer activities for visitors of all ages.
items.zh: 学习实验室提供适合各年龄段访客的活动。

items.en: Visit the cafe for tasty refreshments during your tour.
items.zh: 参观途中可以去咖啡厅享用美味茶点。

items.en: The gift shop sells unique souvenirs at affordable prices.
items.zh: 礼品店以实惠的价格出售独特的纪念品。

items.en: Use the hang and chin-up bars to increase the power of your upper body.
items.zh: 用悬吊杠和引体向上杠来增强你的上肢力量。
chunks: Use the hang and chin-up bars

items.en: Before you leave, check the gym floor plan for specific areas and equipment.
items.zh: 离开前，看一下健身房平面图，找具体的区域和器械。

items.en: If you need help, trained instructors are always nearby to guide and advise you.
items.zh: 如果你需要帮助，训练有素的教练总在附近指导和建议你。
